content: By enforcing the adoption of these sophisticated tracking mechanisms, the regulatory framework directly dictates operational safety standards, ensuring that personnel can be accurately located, monitored, and managed during both routine operations and critical emergency scenarios. In addition to technological mandates for personnel safety, the regulatory framework extensively addresses environmental compliance and hazard mitigation. Legal compliance with regulations addressing ground vibration, noise, and flyrock remains a critical component of the industry's operational mandate, ensuring safer operations and significantly reduced environmental impacts [38] . Furthermore, environmental compliance has been profoundly influenced by the Climate Change Act 22 of 2024, which officially came into force in 2025 [44] . This comprehensive legislative instrument has mandated aggressive decarbonization strategies for the mining sector, compelling companies to adapt their operational practices to meet stringent new environmental standards . Tailings management also continues to play a pivotal role in the broader compliance monitoring ecosystem. These requirements are meticulously designed to mitigate potential environmental and operational hazards, establishing robust foundational compliance frameworks that continue to heavily influence current industry practices and safety audits [35] . Enforcement procedures within the South African mining sector are characterized by rigorous regulatory framework applications that directly impact operational safety standards. Government initiatives, such as nationwide mining safety blitzes, highlight a highly proactive approach to improving workplace conditions and ensuring stricter adherence to established safety standards [36] . These enforcement procedures serve as the primary mechanisms through which the state monitors adherence, utilizing health and safety statistics—such as those recorded in 2024, which provided quantitative insights into industry performance—to gauge regulatory effectiveness and overall worker well-being [32] . The critical importance of continuous compliance is frequently echoed in broader industry discussions, where the readiness of mining operations to withstand rigorous regulatory audits remains a central and recurring theme [32] .
